summary: Iteration 32 retest of the anonymous public player profile flow (the sole gap from iter31). Both the backend and frontend fixes are validated. GET /api/players/profiles/{id} now returns 200 for anonymous callers with `mobile_masked` present and raw `mobile`/`email`/`dob` stripped. /players/profiles/{id} no longer redirects to /players/login for anonymous viewers — page renders player name, avatar, sport cards, and player-tournaments-section. Hidden hosted events remain filtered out for anonymous viewers; public hosted events appear. Regression: all 11 iter31 pytest tests still green. New 3-test suite `test_public_profile_iter32.py` also 3/3 green.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py::get_player_profile now uses get_current_user_optional — correct. Mobile masked with bullet char, email/dob stripped for anon. Nice minimal fix.

PlayerDirectory.jsx::PlayerProfileView effect now runs regardless of auth state — correct. Consider gating the /players/{id}/tournaments call inside PlayerTournamentsSection when anonymous to avoid an extra 404/empty call, but this is cosmetic.
server.py is still ~4400 lines. Continuing route-file extraction (routes/player_profiles.py) would help long-term maintainability — not blocking.

GET /api/events/{id} still returns hidden events when accessed directly by URL for anonymous callers (verified with hidden event page rendering HIDDEN + LOCAL badges without auth). This is expected for owner sharing via link but worth documenting — if 'hidden' should be strictly private, consider gating detail-by-id too.

success_rate.backend: 100% (11/11 iter31 pytest + 3/3 new iter32 anonymous-profile pytest)
success_rate.frontend: 100% for the anonymous profile flow (case #1). Hidden event detail page renders LOCAL MATCH + HIDDEN badges correctly (part of case #3).

context_for_next_testing_agent: The anonymous public profile gap from iter31 is now closed. If future work needs to test /admin's Host-a-local-match form via Playwright, note that Playwright fill() on the /login page's email input sometimes fails to trigger React state updates in this preview; use the backend /api/auth/login curl to obtain a session cookie or emulate typing via page.type() instead of page.fill(). The WelcomeModal (data-testid=welcome-dismiss, z-[60]) still intercepts first-visit clicks — dismiss before interacting. Iter31 already fully validated the /admin form → hidden event → LOCAL+HIDDEN badges flow; this iter32 re-confirmed the badges portion by directly loading the event detail page.
rca of the issue: N/A — bug fix successfully verified. Root cause was two-layer auth guard (FE PlayerDirectory redirect + BE 401), both fixed with minimal deltas. FE effect now unconditionally calls the API once auth state is ready; BE endpoint now depends on get_current_user_optional and redacts sensitive fields when caller is anonymous or non-owner.
